about.heading: Cannon Hood, owner and operator.
about.lead: Hood Recon is one guy who does the work himself.
about.text: Cannon is a certified PDR technician with more than 12 years of hands-on dent repair. He opened Hood Recon in 2023 to give DFW drivers a fair price and a repair they don't have to wonder about.
about.text2: When you book, the person who quotes your dent is the person who fixes it.
